S.FORM: alang Triqan ga niya mki sku Toweng si atu Hosing Ku, kwara sali buwan nya ga 18 buwan, 46 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 93% kyan ku 43 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 7% kyan ku 3 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan93%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Triqan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na Triqan hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Triqan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Triqan hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Triqan hya' ga Kinyawpan. tay mkyahu' na Triqan hya' ga Zihing. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ triqan ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku toweŋ [s|ɕ]i atu ħo[s|ɕ]iŋ ku kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan ** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan** maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na triqan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na triqan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na triqan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na triqan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na triqan ħjaʔ ɣa kinjawpan taj mkjaħuʔ na triqan ħjaʔ ɣa ziħiŋ reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
